description: Slipa turns a rough screen recording into a finished demo video. It transcribes what you said, rewrites it as a clean script, re-voices it with a narrator in any of twenty-nine languages, and renders the result with your logo, brand colours and captions. The narration language is independent of the recording language, so you can record once and publish in another. Ask for a video and Slipa tells you what it will cost before it spends anything.

defaultPrompt: What narration languages and voices can I publish in?
